summary: GREENLIFE ANS (org. no. 976 605 950) is a general partnership (ANS) based in Drammen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-07-29. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 46.380 (Engroshandel med andre næringsmidler); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: David John Christian Gamborg; board chair: David John Christian Gamborg.
